issue: BAT-LOW preceded an unexpected pump stop.
resolution: Service found an intermittently disconnected power lead. Replaced the lead and verified charging under load.

issue: MOTOR_FAULT was logged during infusion while charge was above 70%.
resolution: Engineering confirmed intermittent drive assembly binding, replaced the assembly, and added a diagnostic check.

compliance.item: Drive-system interruption during therapy · device malfunction

issue: An unexpected stop was reported without a timestamp or retained device logs.
resolution: The reviewer requested the shift window and device service records. The case was closed with cause undetermined after the records search.

issue: A motor fault was logged during a bench test after maintenance.
resolution: Service reseated a drive connector and repeated the bench verification successfully.
